scope: Current fixed source-review evidence. Native automation state owns the live cursor and pending work. Git retains replaced evidence; this is not a run log or native definition.

review_summary.tests_read_count_unit: Distinct source path/function identities, separate from shared helpers, parameter expansions, loop scenarios and executed counts. Intermediate reverted bodies carry their original source_revision and are not final-target execution claims.
review_summary.runtime_migration: Necessary retained-capability repairs use the fixed official main artifact. New startup diagnostics and thread/sample product surfaces remain unselected.
review_summary.artifact_readback: All selected component hashes, strict signatures, commit markers and actual generated schema were verified.
review_summary.source_integrity: All official codeload archive blobs match the fixed fetched Git tree, actual package build source and review source. No toolchain source edits; builds explicitly use unversioned stable.
review_summary.limits: Fixed official source; signed private-stdio development runtime on the qualifying macOS arm64 host, Code Mode and rg helpers, affected source tests and retained loopback native consumer regressions. No app installation or release. Thirty-four selected Decodex regressions passed: 32 execute the exact candidate CLI and its packaged helpers; two native_search tests are local projections. The separate explicit old-binary comparison passes the four added consumers with unchanged main-inherited code. No live provider, real account or installed-app acceptance.

test_reconstruction.source: Official archive at implementation_snapshot; for a test with source_revision, read that exact immutable upstream Git revision instead. Compare retained file and body digests. Reverted intermediate bodies are read-only evidence, not final-target test executions.
test_reconstruction.registration: cargo +stable nextest list --locked --cargo-profile release -p <package> <entrypoint flags> -E test(<test>) --message-format json. Use --lib for lib, --test <name> for integration:<name>, and --bin <name> for bin:<name>. Require a nonzero intended match.
test_reconstruction.execution: Use the matching qualification.json source_validation command and inspect actual expanded execution identities.
test_reconstruction.authority: Existing host toolchain, unversioned stable, official local Nextest profile and 8 MiB stack; system-temporary HOME and existing Cargo/Rustup homes.
test_reconstruction.selection_limit: Test-body reads do not imply execution. Qualification records exact selections, counts and the original unmatched selectors.
